source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of collaboration and iteration (PDF 221).

blocks.text: Tawun aur iteration karobari khayalat aur hal ko nikharne mein madad dete hain: log mil kar kaam karte aur raye ke baar baar chakkaron se kaam behtar karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Tawun aur iteration aksar saath kyun istemal hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Shurakaa woh raye dete hain jo iteration ka har chakkar kaam behtar karne mein istemal karta hai.

items: Tawun se khoobiyan share; iteration se qadam ba qadam behtari.
